newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ARBONALE BIDS 612 MLN KROONS FOR ESTONIAN SHIP..
newsitem.headline: ARBONALE BIDS 612 MLN KROONS FOR ESTONIAN SHIP..

text.p: Consortium Arbonale said on Wednesday that has bid 612 million kroons in its privatisation offer for 70 percent shares in Estonian Shipping.
Arbonale will invest 3.55 billion kroons in the company, Toomas Reisenbuk, Arbonale director, said in a statement.

Arbonale was formed by Talinvest, Hansa Investments, N-Terminaal, Norwegian shipping company Navigator, Japanese investment bank Nomura and Hong Kong shipping company Jinhui Shipping and Transportation Ltd.
Other bidder, ESCO Holding, has made a 700 million kroon bid for the company and has said it will invest 3.1 billion kroons.
Esco Holding is held 50 percent by Norwegian Tschudi & Eitzen, 12 percent by Uhisinvesteeringud, the investment company of Uhispank , and 10 percent by Stanton Capital Corporation from the U.S.
Investment house Baltic Cresco has 10 percent, the management of Estonian Shipping another 10 percent and eight percent belongs to EPEKS, an Estonian food production company.
The privatisation agency will make a decision on the best bidder for the shipping company by June 11.
